violations.finding: Test-fixture paths hardcode '/root/travel-planner/.claude/skills/{G}/skill.md' and '/root/travel-planner/data/foo.json' as string literals instead of deriving from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. Line 81 sets CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR='/root/travel-planner' as a fallback when unset, which keeps the script working under the current layout but the read-path CASES on lines 66-69 and 75 never consult that variable. Moving the script (or running it from a worktree) breaks the read-path matcher tests.
violations.recommendation: Replace hardcoded prefixes with f-strings against an env-resolved base, e.g. `BASE = os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR', '/root/travel-planner')` then `f"{BASE}/.claude/skills/{G}/skill.md"`. Keeps the parameterized-default pattern already used on lines 16, 30, 81.
